subject: Startups
title: YouTube's Embed Strategy
description: A micro-lesson that makes YouTube's Embed Strategy usable.

hook.text: YouTube didn't just host videos. It let anyone embed them on any website. That one decision changed the internet.

buildup.text: Competitors like Google Video kept users locked in. YouTube gave away embed codes for free to anyone.

discovery.text: Bloggers, news sites, and forums all embedded YouTube videos. Every embed was a portal back to YouTube.

twist.text: YouTube turned the entire web into its distribution network. Other video sites tried to hoard traffic and lost.

climax.text: Within 18 months, YouTube served 100 million videos daily. Google bought it for $1.65 billion in 2006.

punchline.text: Give your product away and the web does your marketing.

quiz.question: What strategy helped YouTube beat competitors like Google Video?
options: Free embed codes for any website
